instruction.name: vpermi.w
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, use `imm[1:0]` and `imm[3:2]` to select words 0 and 1 from `b`, and `imm[5:4]` and `imm[7:6]` to select words 2 and 3 from `a`; store the result in `dst`.
